project_subtitle: Secure Online College Election Management System

design_direction.theme: Institutional Security Dark Navy & Cyan (NavyStack Architecture)
design_direction.mood: Authoritative, Trustworthy, Cryptographically Auditable, High-Precision SaaS

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-50
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100
rules.code_hash: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wider text-cyan-400 bg-slate-900/80 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-cyan-500/20

footer_requirements.style: py-8 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono tracking-wide

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B132B]/80 border-b border-slate-800/80 px-4 lg:px-8 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between
elements: VoteSecure Shield & Lock Logo (Cyan/Blue gradient text)
Role Switcher / Navigation Tabs (Public, Student, Admin, Auditor, System Operator)
Session State (Logged in user badge, department, verification tag, logout button)

sidebar.style: w-64 bg-[#0F172A] border-r border-slate-800 h-[calc(100vh-65px)] sticky top-[65px] p-4 space-y-2 hidden md:block

sections: Hero Section with cryptographic security assurance badge, live election ticker, quick access CTAs (Vote Now / Register)
Institutional Trust Pillars (Zero-Knowledge Hash Receipts, Immutable Audit Trail, Multi-Role Governance)
Public Election Schedule & Official Results Portal

student_portal.registration: Fields: Full Name, Registration Number (e.g., BCA20240412), Department, Semester (1-8), Official College Email, Password. Clear validation message on pending admin verification.
student_portal.login: Email & Password. Password recovery flow with Admin-Issued Reset Token modal/page.

dashboard.status_banner: Student Identity Verification Status (Pending / Approved / Rejected) with department info
dashboard.eligible_elections: Active elections for student's department & semester

voting_flow.step_1: Candidate selection grid with candidate bios, manifestos, photo avatars
voting_flow.step_2: Review-Before-Submit modal modal/view with selected candidate details & warning that votes cannot be altered
voting_flow.step_3: Confirmation modal with cryptographic SHA-256 voting hash receipt generator & downloadable verification proof
voting_flow.step_4: Voted state displaying locked receipt token and timestamp

dashboard.participation_history: List of past elections voted in with verification hash tokens

tabs: Verification Queue (Approve/Reject student accounts with search and department filters)
CSV Student Registry Import (File upload, column mapper, data preview table, dry-run validation report)
Elections Management (Lifecycle: Draft -> Scheduled -> Open -> Closed -> Finalized. Action controls per stage)
Candidates Approval & Eligibility Manager (Add candidates, assign to elections/positions, set criteria)
Turnout Analytics (Recharts visualizations for hourly voting curve, department turnout %, semester breakdown)
Reconciliation & Two-Person Approvals (Double-signoff requirement before finalizing election results)

features: Audit Event Viewer (Filterable real-time event log with event type, actor ID, IP hash, timestamp, payload)
Hash-Chain Integrity Verification Tool (Recompute block hashes, detect tampering, visual status indicator)
Reconciliation Audit Reports (Discrepancy detection, turnout vs ballot count verification, export PDF/JSON)
System Health & Operational Status (CPU/Memory simulated telemetry, API response times)
Sanitized Exception & Error Logs (No sensitive data exposed)

empty_states.rule: Must show clean, professional empty states when data is empty. NO fake placeholder rows.
empty_states.style: p-12 text-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/40 text-slate-400 space-y-3
empty_states.components: Lucide icon (e.g. Inbox, ShieldAlert, FileText), clean headline, brief explanatory paragraph, action button if applicable.

data_testing_convention.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-role college election management web app in React JS + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn components.
Ensure dark navy (#0B132B) background foundation with cyan (#00E5FF) and electric blue (#3A86FF) accents.
Implement clear role switching in header for testing all flows: Public Homepage, Student, Admin, Auditor, and System Operator.

Provide real state management (in-memory/localStorage or mock service layer) allowing full election workflow execution: Student Registration -> Admin CSV import / account approval -> Election Creation (Draft to Open) -> Student Vote Submit -> Review Modal -> Receipt Generation -> Turnout Charting -> Reconciliation -> Auditor Hash Verification -> Finalization.
Display real empty states when queues or election lists are empty.
Strictly follow footer credit requirement: 'Built and developed by Hriata_khuptong'.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and key indicators.
